context.transcript:
Thank you for calling the tech help hotline for DHJ software, the makers of the Borata software program.
We are aware of an issue with the program.
Users are currently receiving error messages when attempting to download files.
Our engineers are working to correct this, and an automatic program update should be available shortly.
If you are calling about program tutorials, you can find all training videos on our Web site.
Don't forget, we still have a discount for users buying 50 or more copies of the program, so be sure to indicate this when placing a purchase order.
Thank you for choosing DHJ software.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢您致电 DHJ 软件的技术支持热线，我们是 Borata 软件程序的制造商。
我们知道程序存在问题。
用户在尝试下载文件时收到了错误消息。
我们的工程师正在努力纠正这个问题，很快就会提供自动程序更新。
如果您打电话咨询程序教程，可以在我们的网站上找到所有培训视频。
别忘了，对于购买 50 个或更多副本的用户，我们仍然有折扣，所以在下采购订单时一定要说明这一点。
感谢您选择 DHJ 软件。
